source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 27 in Front-Load Gas & Electric Dryers Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered. Use Key Activation, fault scroll, or Service Test as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Service Diagnostic moisture test
steps.body: Enter Service Diagnostic Mode. Open door. Touch both moisture strips with wet cloth or finger — repeating beep and alphanumeric display = pass.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Service Diagnostic Mode. Open door. Touch both moisture strips with wet cloth or finger — repeating beep and alphanumeric display = pass.

steps.title: Wet-cloth test result
steps.body: Repeating beep and number on display when both strips touched?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repeating beep and number on display when both strips touched?

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: No beep or beep before touch — continue bench checks.

steps.title: Bench moisture harness check
steps.body: Power off. Remove console/front panel. Disconnect 3-wire moisture sensor below door. Remove J13 at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Remove console/front panel. Disconnect 3-wire moisture sensor below door. Remove J13 at ACU.

steps.title: J13 harness continuity
steps.body: Continuity from J13 at ACU to moisture sensor connector.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity from J13 at ACU to moisture sensor connector.

steps.title: Outermost contacts (with MOVs)
steps.body: Small resistance across outer contacts → clean metal strips; if still low, replace sensor harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Small resistance across outer contacts → clean metal strips; if still low, replace sensor harness.

steps.title: Outer contacts to center ground
steps.body: Each outer contact to center terminal must read infinity (OL).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Each outer contact to center terminal must read infinity (OL).

steps.title: Rear moisture sensor (Quad Sense)
steps.body: Some Maytag models: repeat steps 6–10 using connector J23 for rear moisture sensor (F3E5).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Some Maytag models: repeat steps 6–10 using connector J23 for rear moisture sensor (F3E5).

steps.title: Outlet thermistor follow-up
steps.body: If auto-dry still stops early after sensor OK, run TEST #4a outlet thermistor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If auto-dry still stops early after sensor OK, run TEST #4a outlet thermistor.

steps.title: Replace harness/sensor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace moisture sensor harness or sensor assembly.

steps.title: Moisture sensor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Service mode and bench checks pass.
